main_body: Autumn tree: a large orange-red leaf canopy (rows 1-28) on a thin brown trunk (rows 29-44) with a dark base
top_band: Canopy: orange highlights at rows 5-7 on the upper dome, then mid and dark reds below. It reads as a rounded organic mass, not a flat top band.
evidence: The canopy is a domed mass with a lit upper surface and a darker underside. The trunk goes beneath it with a shadow where the canopy overhangs. This is a normal organic tree volume, with no receding side face or flat elevation. The kind is organic, so the construction passes.

style.evidence: The candidate has only 10 distinct colours and a median of 5 per tile, against 108-109 per tile and 427-567 colours in the references. The canopy has speckled clumps in about 4 reds and oranges, but the clumps are coarse and have little leaf-by-leaf shading. The trunk is a flat brown with a near-black navy outline (28% neutral dark edge pixels, so mixed) and 3-4 tones, much thinner than the references' detailed trunks, roots and branches. The tree reads flatter and more sticker-like than the references, so it fails.
